template.name: Landledger: tool or seat cost
template.description: A paid seat is spend: when someone asks Landbright for access to a bundle whose app costs a seat, this flow finds the Landledger contract that grants the app and raises a tool_or_seat request for one seat at the contract's price, naming the person (who confirms it in Landledger). Landledger's approvers decide the cost and Landbright's the access; the flow tells Landbright what Landledger decided (a note on the request, or its external cost step once Landbright builds it, behind a setting), marks the seat used when the grant is live, and gives it back when access is denied or the grant is revoked.

credentials.name: Landledger (requests)
credentials.description: Landledger's API URL (in the cluster http://landledger-api.landflow-dev.svc.cluster.local:4810, on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810) and an ll_ key with read and requests:write (it raises, marks applied and releases its own requests). Never decisions:relay or admin.

credentials.name: Landledger (webhooks)
credentials.description: Landledger's API URL (in the cluster http://landledger-api.landflow-dev.svc.cluster.local:4810, on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810) and an ll_ key with webhooks:write only: the Landledger Trigger subscribes itself on publish. Or the whsec_ secret of a webhook an admin made.

credentials.name: Landbright events
credentials.description: JWT Auth with key type JWKS: Landbright's <issuer>/jwks, its issuer and the subscription's audience. No secret is shared.

credentials.name: Landbright API
credentials.description: OAuth2 client credentials of the Landflow application in Landbright, with requests:read and annotations:write (and steps:settle once Landbright has the external cost step).

setup: Pick or add **Landledger (requests)**: an `ll_` key with `read` and `requests:write`, and **Landledger (webhooks)** for **Landledger events**: a key of its own with only `webhooks:write`.
Pick or add **Landbright events** (JWT Auth against Landbright's JWKS) and **Landbright API** (the Landflow application's client credentials: `requests:read`, `annotations:write`).
In **Settings**, set `LANDBRIGHT_URL` and, until Landbright marks a seat cost on the bundle's target, `SEAT_APPS`: a bundle's name → the `landbrightApp` its Landledger contract names.

Publish, then subscribe **Landbright events**' production URL in Landbright (Events) to `request.created`, `request.decided`, `grant.activated`, `grant.revoked` and `grant.expired`. Publishing subscribes **Landledger events** to `request.decided` for `tool_or_seat` requests.

A request for a seat: **Find the contract** (Contract → Seats); none → a note on the Landbright request and nothing raised; else **Ask Landledger for the seat** (one seat at the contract's price, idempotency key `landbright-<REQ-n>`), recorded in **Landledger seat requests**, and a note on the Landbright request.

Landledger's decision: **Ours to act on?** trusts only this key's request from a run of this workflow, then **Tell Landbright the cost** notes it on the Landbright request. **Settle the cost step** calls Landbright's proposed `POST /api/v1/requests/:id/steps/:step/settle`: leave `SETTLE_IN_LANDBRIGHT` off until Landbright builds it.

Landbright's decision or a grant change: granted → **Mark the seat used** (Request → Mark Applied); access denied with the cost approved → **Release the seat** (`access_denied`); the grant revoked or expired → **Release the seat** (`grant_revoked`, or `not_needed` for a seat never used).

workflow.name: Landledger: tool or seat cost
workflow.description: A Landbright access request for a seat raises a tool_or_seat request in Landledger on the contract that grants the app; Landledger's decision is noted on the Landbright request (or settles its cost step, behind a setting); the grant marks the seat used, a denial or revocation releases it.

nodes.name: Landbright events
nodes.notes: Subscribe this URL in Landbright (Events) to request.created, request.decided, grant.activated, grant.revoked and grant.expired. The event is the signed JWT's, checked against Landbright's JWKS.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: Landbright's URL, which bundles cost a seat, and whether to settle Landbright's cost step (off until Landbright builds it).

nodes.name: Find the contract
nodes.notes: Contract → Seats: the contract that grants the app, its seat price and seats left; found: false when none does.

nodes.name: Ask Landledger for the seat

parameters.title: {{ $json.contract.vendor }} seat for {{ $('Costs a seat?').first().json.subject }} ({{ $('Costs a seat?').first().json.ref }})
parameters.note: Access to {{ $('Costs a seat?').first().json.bundle }} in Landbright ({{ $('Costs a seat?').first().json.ref }}) takes a {{ $json.contract.vendor }} {{ $json.contract.product }} seat: {{ $json.left }} left on the contract.
parameters.evidence: {{ { lines: [{ label: $json.contract.vendor + ' ' + $json.contract.product + ' seat', amount: $json.seatPrice }], basis: 'The contract\'s price per seat a month', links: [{ label: $('Costs a seat?').first().json.ref, url: $('Costs a seat?').first().json.url }] } }}

requestFields.originTitle: Tool or seat cost (Landbright {{ $('Costs a seat?').first().json.ref }})

nodes.notes: Raised by this flow's key naming the person who asked: they confirm it in Landledger, then the cost center's owner decides with the seats left in front of them. The idempotency key is the Landbright request, so a retried run raises it once.

nodes.name: Remember the seat request
nodes.notes: Which run raised which seat request, and for which Landbright request: the decision and the grant are matched through it.

parameters.body: {{ { value: { status: 'cost_asked', landledgerRequest: $('Ask Landledger for the seat').first().json.request.number, landledgerRequestId: $('Ask Landledger for the seat').first().json.request.id, text: 'The seat\'s cost is asked in Landledger as ' + $('Ask Landledger for the seat').first().json.request.number + '; its approvers decide the cost, Landbright\'s the access.' } } }}

nodes.name: No contract: say so in Landbright

parameters.body: {{ { value: { status: 'no_contract', app: $json.landbrightApp, text: 'No Landledger contract grants ' + $json.landbrightApp + ': Finance imports the contract first. No cost request was raised.' } } }}

nodes.name: Get the request
nodes.notes: Read it fresh: the webhook's copy is not what the checks trust.

nodes.name: Find the run that raised it
Tell Landbright the cost

parameters.body: {{ { value: { status: $json.outcome === 'approved' ? 'cost_approved' : 'cost_denied', landledgerRequest: $json.number, landledgerRequestId: $json.landledgerRequestId, reason: $json.reason, text: $json.outcome === 'approved' ? 'Landledger approved the seat\'s cost (' + $json.number + '); the seat is reserved. Landbright\'s approvers still decide the access.' : 'Landledger did not approve the seat\'s cost (' + $json.number + '): ' + $json.reason } } }}

nodes.notes: A note on the Landbright request (annotation landflow.seat_cost), shown on its page. Until Landbright has an external cost step, this is all the flow can tell it: access and cost are decided apart.

nodes.name: Settle the cost step

parameters.url: {{ $('Ours to act on?').first().json.landbrightUrl }}/api/v1/requests/{{ $('Ours to act on?').first().json.landbrightRequestId }}/steps/{{ $('Ours to act on?').first().json.costStep }}/settle
parameters.body: {{ { outcome: $('Ours to act on?').first().json.outcome, reference: $('Ours to act on?').first().json.landledgerRequestId } }}

nodes.notes: Placeholder for Landbright's proposed external step (POST /api/v1/requests/:id/steps/:step/settle { outcome, reference }, scope steps:settle). Not built in Landbright yet: Settings keeps it off.

nodes.name: Not settled: the setting is off
Not this flow's: refused
nodes.notes: Ours to act on? says why: another key raised it, its origin is forged or another workflow's, or it is not approved any more. Nothing is told to Landbright.

nodes.name: Find its seat request
nodes.notes: Only Landbright requests this flow raised a seat request for; anything else stops here.

nodes.name: Mark the seat used
nodes.notes: Landledger: approved → applied; the seat moves from reserved to used.

nodes.name: Release the seat
nodes.notes: The seat goes back to the contract and the request's reservations are released (Landledger sends seat.released).
